services.desc: For the closing of Within Others exhibition, Edge on the Square presents an experimental live sound bath by Jeffrey Yip x Macro Waves and a Tai Chi workshop by Melissa "Alex" Medel on Friday, May 31, 5:00 - 7:00 PM. In the act of re-gathering, we reimagine and remember the transformative power that lies within ourselves and within others, letting the forces of collective care draw us towards each other and towards Collective Futures. Melissa "Alex" Medel debuted her official teaching career for San Francisco Recreation and Parks Department in 2016.
